profile.headline: Software Engineer at Valley Bank | .NET, Azure, Microservices | BSCS | Photographer & Business Owner
profile.summary:
Passionate about building things with code and learning and growing as much as possible.

I became a software engineer because I was a MySpace kid in 2005 who wanted a glitter cursor and a MIDI file that autoplayed the second you clicked into my page. I had no idea any of that counted as a skill. I just knew I loved coding to make my profile look exactly how I wanted it to.

My path here wasn't very linear. After almost a decade as a self-taught web developer, I started to feel stagnant and thus went back to school to pursue a Computer Science degree. In the midst of that, I endured a layoff, then a marketing-heavy role to stay afloat that transitioned into a mobile app team, then a 6-month internship, then finally landed my dream as a software developer role. None of it was part of the plan. It was mostly reinvention and figuring it out as I went.

And I really love this work. In a "I will happily lose an hour to a bug just because I need to know why it's happening" or "let's jump on the work computer first thing Saturday morning to check this script" way.

Right now, at Valley Bank, I'm building a full-stack file viewer replacing a clunky legacy desktop tool, spread across five microservices on AKS. I also built a customer search microservice for financial data matching, and I served as solution architect on an AI chatbot initiative.

Through all of this, I've also been shooting weddings and running Caitee Smith Photography. That's why I'm building Dossier on the side, a studio management app for photographers, because I got sick of duct-taping together five different tools just to run one business.
 
Outside of all this, I'm passionate about hiking in the ADKs (I currently have 35 out of 46 High Peaks), snowboarding, kayaking, riding my motorcycle or driving my STI, roller skating, and always plotting the next trip to somewhere with mountains.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
◦ Built and deployed a full-stack internal file viewer, replacing a legacy desktop application with a Vue.js, .NET 10, Azure Blob Storage, and SQL Server solution featuring SSO, filtered search, pagination, and chunked file streaming across five AKS-deployed microservices.
◦ Delivered 8+ C#/.NET 8 Azure Function microservices backed by Cosmos DB, powering a product health notification system tracking 150+ products with a redesigned Vue.js dashboard and numerous new features.
 ◦ Developed a HotList customer search microservice supporting multi-criteria queries across regulated financial datasets, integrating SQL Server with layered validation and OpenAPI-documented contracts.
 ◦ Served as solution architect for a Streamlit/Python/DataRobot chatbot, producing technical solution designs and system diagrams, then productionized the prototype by containerizing it, implementing SSO, and deploying to AKS via Helm charts and Azure DevOps pipelines.
 ◦ Developed Python workflows to automate data transformation and synchronization into Cosmos DB.
 ◦ Authored and maintained OpenAPI specifications across microservices, establishing consistent API contracts for cross-team integration.
 ◦ Resolved Snyk-flagged security vulnerabilities through targeted refactoring, including AutoMapper breaking changes.
 ◦ Diagnosed and resolved production incidents in a regulated financial environment, including CAB submission and audit readiness.
 ◦ Strengthened system reliability through structured logging and standardized response envelopes.
 ◦ Supported code quality and team growth through PR reviews, documentation, and mentorship of junior developers on clean architecture and testing standards.
positions.insights: Skills: C# · Azure DevOps Services · REST APIs · Terraform · Unit Testing · Vue.js · Front-End Development

projects.title: Dossier: CRM & Studio Management
projects.description:
- Designed and built Dossier as a solo side project to replace the fragmented mix of tools wedding photographers rely on: combining lead management, bookings, contracts, invoicing, client communication, and day-of workflow into a single application. Built from firsthand experience as a working wedding photographer.
- Built on React, Vite, and TypeScript on the frontend with an .NET 10 REST API backend, EF Core, and Supabase PostgreSQL as the data layer. Supabase Auth handles authentication with JWTs validated at the API layer. Deployed to Netlify (frontend) and Railway (API).
- Features a drag-and-drop lead kanban with a 9-stage booking workflow pipeline (Lead through Complete), a full booking detail view with tabs for tasks, timeline, shot list, vendors, and sessions. Includes a rich text contract editor with inline variable tokens and signature capture, a questionnaire builder, invoice management with a payment schedule structure, and a client-facing portal with magic link authentication.
- Additional tools include a sunset and golden hour calculator using a NOAA solar algorithm with local timezone handling, a cost-of-doing-business calculator, a workflow and editing time estimator, and an AI blog post generator powered by the Anthropic API. Contracts support PDF export.
- Sole developer across the full stack: data modeling, API design, React component architecture, Supabase migrations, auth flow, and deployment configuration.

projects.title: MIRE: Synergy Internal File Viewer
projects.description:
- Built and deployed a full-stack internal document management application as the sole developer within a four-week deadline, replacing a legacy desktop tool used across the bank. Internal users can search, paginate, and view bank reports directly in the browser with SSO-secured access.
- Built on Vue 3, ASP.NET Core (.NET 10), Azure Blob Storage, and SQL Server, with chunked streaming for large file handling, deployed to AKS across five microservices following an API-led connectivity architecture (Experience, Process, and System layers) with Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines.
- Designed the full custom UI from scratch, including a split-pane layout with a filterable search panel featuring typed inputs, dropdowns, date filters, result highlighting, and loading states. The file viewer includes a context-aware toolbar with in-file search, filter mode toggle, zoom controls, print, standard and encrypted export with a password prompt flow, and both PDF and plain text rendering with mode-specific toolbar variants. Light/dark theme support with Valley brand token integration.
- Sole developer across the full lifecycle: architecture design, custom UI, pagination, SSO integration, OpenAPI specifications, Vitest and NUnit test coverage, and Helm chart deployment.
